name: Nice table
description: You are given an $$$n \times m$$$ table, consisting of characters « A », « G », « C », « T ». Let's call a table nice , if every $$$2 \times 2$$$ square contains all four distinct characters. Your task is to find a nice table (also consisting of « A », « G », « C », « T »), that differs from the given table in the minimum number of characters.
input_specification: First line contains two positive integers $$$n$$$ and $$$m$$$ — number of rows and columns in the table you are given ($$$2 \leq n, m, n \times m \leq 300\,000$$$). Then, $$$n$$$ lines describing the table follow. Each line contains exactly $$$m$$$ characters « A », « G », « C », « T ».
output_specification: Output $$$n$$$ lines, $$$m$$$ characters each. This table must be nice and differ from the input table in the minimum number of characters.
approach_summary: Identify exchange argument or greedy choice property. Sort elements by payoff ratio or deadline and greedily pick candidates to achieve global optimum.
